canonical_statement: A stochastic process is Gaussian if and only if each restriction to a finite set of indices has a Gaussian law.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Type u_1, E : Type u_2, T : Type u_3; proposition in Prop
conclusion: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussianProcess X P iff for every I : Finset T, ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (fun omega => I.restrict (X . omega)) P
boundary_convention: The empty finite index set is included. No nondegeneracy, centeredness, continuity, independence, or covariance hypothesis is added.

alternate_encodings.target: forall I : Finset T, HasGaussianLaw (fun omega => I.restrict (X . omega)) P
